text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on St Albans Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for prohibiting heavy vehicles at all times on St Albans Road, between Kipling Avenue and Aukland Road. Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services recommends prohibiting heavy vehicles at all times.
City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit heavy vehicles at all times on St Albans Road, between Kipling Avenue and Aukland Road.
